title: The policy wiki design record

steps.title: IDs
steps.body: Document ID = the immutable page_id. Slugs change on rename, so they are never IDs.

steps.title: Permissions
steps.body: Read groups become allowedGroups; both-groups rules become one intersection entry; nurse leads nest with memberGroupName.

steps.title: Freshness
steps.body: Incremental every hour from a checkpoint written on success.

steps.title: Deletion
steps.body: Tombstones delete explicitly each hour. Tombstones last 30 days, so a nightly full run reconciles anything missed.

steps.title: Guard
steps.body: Raise on an empty page before the end; halt if the count falls well beyond expected churn.

steps.title: Operations
steps.body: Secrets in the secret store; alert on a sharp drop in indexed documents.

footnote: Composite, fictional case used across this accreditation. Product behavior is sourced; the customer environment and its numbers are invented for practice.
